phases.label: uma_1
phases.event: A 10-second segment of the UMa route. The channel comes from the trace, not from this phase.
phases.note: Phases only mark time here and renegotiate every 10 s; mcs_index is a fallback used only if the trace is missing, and the logged base MCS is computed from the traced ceilings instead.
